name: Wireless router
definition: network device that routes traffic and provides wireless access.
notes: TP-Link lists WiFi routers, travel routers, gaming routers, VPN routers

name: Access point
definition: network device that adds wireless access to a wired network.
notes: TP-Link lists standalone Wi-Fi access points (TL-WA series) and UniFi sells ceiling APs

name: Network switch
definition: network device that connects wired devices on a local network.
notes: TP-Link lists unmanaged desktop and rackmount PoE switches

name: UPS
definition: uninterruptible power supply that keeps equipment running through a mains failure (a portable power station is B7).
notes: CyberPower and Eaton sell battery-backup UPS for PCs and networking

name: USB cable
definition: cable with USB connectors.
notes: Anker lists USB-C to USB-C and USB-A to USB-C cables

name: HDMI cable
definition: cable with HDMI connectors.
notes: HDMI 2.1 cable sold by StarTech.com; retailer category HDMI cables

name: Instrument cable
definition: cable with standard connectors for connecting an instrument.
notes: Sweetwater category Guitar / Instrument Cables with 1/4 inch TS plugs

name: Microphone cable
definition: cable with standard connectors for connecting a microphone.
notes: XLR microphone cables sold; also XLR to 1/4 inch mic cables

name: LAN cable
definition: network cable with standard patch connectors.
notes: Cable Matters sells Cat6, Cat6A and Cat8 Ethernet patch cables

name: MIDI cable
definition: cable with MIDI connectors.
notes: Hosa and others sell 5-pin DIN MIDI cables

name: Adapter or hub
definition: device that converts one standard connector to another or splits one port into several.
notes: Satechi USB-C Multi-Port Adapter adds HDMI, Ethernet, USB-A and card slots

name: Docking station
definition: base that carries power delivery and several outputs for a laptop, which an adapter or hub does not.
notes: Thunderbolt 4 docks with PD charging, e.g. CalDigit TS4

name: Generic charger
definition: charger for many devices (USB, GaN or Qi); a charger made for one device follows it.
notes: GaN USB-C wall charger with PD, QC and PPS for many devices

name: Audio cable
definition: audio cable with standard connectors.
notes: Monoprice sells 3.5mm TRS stereo AUX cable male to male

name: Point-of-sale terminal
definition: terminal at which a sale is rung up and paid.
notes: Square Terminal and Square Register sell and take payments at the counter

name: Payment card reader
definition: device that reads payment cards.
notes: Square Reader for contactless and chip takes card payments with a phone or tablet

name: Cash register
definition: till that records sales and holds cash.
notes: Casio SE-S400 cash register with thermal printer and drawer

name: Security key
definition: device used to prove identity when signing in.
notes: Yubico Security Key Series FIDO2 keys for sign-in

name: Hardware wallet
definition: device that holds cryptocurrency keys.
notes: Ledger sells hardware wallets (signers) holding crypto keys offline

name: Single-board computer
definition: board that runs an operating system (a board that does is this kind even with a microcontroller beside it).
notes: Raspberry Pi 5 Model B with RP1 I/O controller, microSD slot, USB and PCIe

name: Microcontroller board
definition: board that runs one program on a microcontroller.
notes: Arduino UNO R4 Minima and WiFi microcontroller boards on Renesas RA4M1

name: Capacitor
definition: passive component that stores charge.
notes: Mouser Passive Components lists Capacitors

name: Resistor
definition: passive component that resists current.
notes: Mouser lists Resistors; through-hole and surface mount

name: Inductor
definition: passive component that stores energy in a magnetic field.
notes: Mouser lists Inductors, Chokes and Coils

name: Microcontroller chip
definition: loose integrated circuit that holds a processor, memory and ports.
notes: Mouser lists Microcontrollers - MCU as loose ICs

name: MOSFET
definition: loose transistor used as a switch or amplifier.
notes: Mouser filter list shows MOSFETs under Semiconductors

name: Relay
definition: loose switch operated by an electromagnet.
notes: Mouser lists Relays, Contactors and Solenoids

name: Component connector
definition: loose connector for circuit boards and wiring.
notes: Mouser lists headers, wire housings, board-to-board and USB connectors

name: Sensor
definition: loose component that senses a physical quantity.
notes: Mouser lists Sensors such as temperature, pressure, magnetic and optical

name: Electronics component kit
definition: component kit without an experiment programme.
notes: SparkFun 1/4W resistor assortment kit of 500; no experiment programme

name: Blank RFID tag or card
definition: unissued RFID tag or card (an issued card is F5).
notes: Blank 13.56MHz NTAG215 NFC card sold unprogrammed

name: Ink cartridge
definition: ink supply made for one printer type.
notes: HP 62 black ink cartridge designed for HP printers; compatibility list on retailers

name: Toner cartridge
definition: toner supply made for one printer type.
notes: Brother TN-760 toner cartridge with list of compatible Brother laser printers

name: 3D-printer filament
definition: filament made for 3D printers.
notes: Polymaker PLA filament 1.75mm for 3D printers

name: Laptop AC adapter
definition: power adapter made for one laptop.
notes: Dell 65W power adapter dedicated to Dell laptops

name: Laptop battery
definition: battery made for one laptop.
notes: Micro Center internal replacement laptop batteries by model; Dell, HP, Apple, Lenovo
